description: The plot illustrates the relationship between iteration number and loss for different training configurations. The x-axis, labeled “#Iteration”, is linear, ranging from 95000 to 125000 with tick marks every 10000 units. The y-axis, labeled “Loss”, is linear, ranging from 2.0 to 3.0 with tick marks every 0.2 units.  A magenta line, labeled “SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)”, begins at approximately 2.92 at an iteration of 95000 and descends to approximately 2.32 at an iteration of 125000, with a steeper decline between iterations 95000 and 105000. A dark blue line, labeled “SepLLM (n=128)”, starts at approximately 2.88 at an iteration of 95000 and decreases to approximately 2.38 at an iteration of 125000, exhibiting a similar pattern of decline. An orange line, labeled “SepLLM (n=64)”, begins at approximately 2.86 at an iteration of 95000 and descends to approximately 2.36 at an iteration of 125000, also with a steeper decline at the beginning of the range. A red dashed line, labeled “Vanilla before post-training”, remains relatively constant across the x-axis, starting at approximately 2.34 at an iteration of 95000 and ending at approximately 2.34 at an iteration of 125000.
